title: Hiking Trip Planner Printable, Hike Log PDF, Day Hike Planner, Trail Route Notes, Pre Hike Checklist, Season Tracker, Gift for Hikers
description:
One page per hike. Fill the top half the night before, the bottom half when you get home. It puts the route, the turnaround time and who knows where you went on paper, and afterwards what actually happened.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Trip Planner: destination, conditions, people, logistics, turnaround plan
- Route Notes: junctions, water sources, escape routes and warnings
- Pre-Departure Check: the ten minutes before you lock the door
- Hike Log: actual distance, time, gear you didn't use, what you'd change
- Season Overview: every hike on one page, with running totals

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions, print-ready
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Print as many pages as you need for your own hikes. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
